title: Smiling Young Family with Baby Outdoors, 1970s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming square snapshot of a young American family posed outdoors circa 1970. The father sports a modern late-1960s/early-1970s style with tinted eyeglasses, a patterned button-up shirt, and an open cardigan sweater. Beside him, the mother beams with long hair and a tailored blouse. Together they hold their cheerful infant child, dressed in a knit playsuit and white soft-soled booties, against a backdrop of trees and a suburban home.
